source.original_title: 05/14/2026 - Mike Sicoli & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/14/2026 - Mike Sicoli & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Closed

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Kim should have let you know. It was my apologies. I forgot to press send about 10 minutes before the call.

prospect.name: Mike Sicoli
prospect.occupation: Owner of a combined commercial cleaning and pressure-washing company he started around 19; manages employees and runs sales himself. Building the business to sell within 2-3 years.
prospect.family_status: Single, no children; has nieces through his brother. Italian family from southern Italy, holds Italian citizenship.
prospect.training_background: Played football (soccer) for 18 years to a high level until age 18, stopped roughly nine years ago; now plays occasional indoor pickup once a week in winter. Training consistently for the past four months — 30-40 minute gym sessions, bodyweight and calisthenics, some isolation work. Has previously hired a weight-training personal trainer. Has already done Trevor's free social-media workouts.
prospect.medical: Multiple longstanding, on-and-off joint problems, volunteered unprompted: shoulder pain, tightness through the back and chest, right knee, and tennis elbow that flares specifically on overhead pressing — "So I can't do is like overhead. It tends to hurt when I use like any machines, when I'm doing triceps". Knee investigated with X-rays and MRI which showed the musculature around the knee had significantly diminished after he stopped playing football. No clinician, physio or clearance status was ever asked about.

signals: Self-rated 5-6 out of 10 on athletic potential and wants 9-10 — 'I'm just trying to better myself in every area of my life'
Business owner, already training consistently, lean in summer, 20,000 steps a day, does quarterly multi-day water fasts — no rescue narrative
Zero price resistance: sells high-ticket himself (2,000-15,000 jobs) and treated 6K as a mechanics question, not a barrier — 'let's make you a sale today'
Deviation worth noting: he carries four distinct joint complaints, which the optimizer archetype does not anticipate

goals.text: Get a bit leaner and steadily look good
Enhance longevity — be able to do at 40 and 50 what he can do in his 20s, like the 90-year-olds in southern Italy who still walk normally
Get rid of the shoulder, knee and elbow issues that stop him doing certain movements
Make fitness a settled part of his routine so it stops sitting in the back of his mind
Perform better and last longer as an operator running his company
Be guided by an actual human rather than self-directing off the internet

pains.text: Shoulder pain, chest and back tightness and tennis elbow that actively prevent certain lifts, especially overhead pressing
Right knee problem with imaging showing muscle around the knee significantly diminished after he stopped playing football
Time management 'all over the place' because of the business — cannot take 45 minutes for himself without interruption
Training consistently but not productively — 30-40 minutes, heart rate never gets there, 'I'm just not performing where I think I could be at the gym'
Self-directed via ChatGPT and YouTube research but loses balance and doubts he is doing movements correctly
Wearing every hat in the business until cash flow allows him to hire administrative help

objections.raw_quote: Realistically, though, is it actually him or he has, like, people just answering? Yeah, it's a question. I know the background things of how a lot of these things work
objections.rep_response: Validated the question ('It's a fair question, brother') and answered that he gets Trevor's personal WhatsApp; gave no proof or process detail beyond that

objections.raw_quote: to be straight up honest, like if it's going to be like some sort of just selling a course type thing, like I'm not looking for that at all, I don't buy those things. I'm looking more for an actual, like, like an actual service. Just show me your real service.
objections.rep_response: Differentiated by pointing at the separate Skool programme as the thing course-buyers take, positioning the 1:1 as the personalised alternative — 'Some people, the school program that we have is generally what they're looking for'

offer.payment_plan_terms: Options named but none selected on record: Klarna (rep noted it carries interest), credit card described as the most popular route, and in-house payment plans 'just splitting it into two or three'. Prospect raised Split It as a 0% alternative and asked whether he could run it through his company as a write-off.

evidence: Explicit verbal agreement: rep asked 'So yeah, ready to rock and roll?' and the prospect answered 'Yeah, let's make you a sale today.'
Rep confirmed 'Let's do it' and immediately moved to process: 'Okay, so I'm just gonna remove the notetaker firstly.'
Prospect had already done the arithmetic himself and accepted it — 'So it's 1K a month. You saved three grand' — and asked how payments are handled

Counter-evidence: no payment, no payment link and no confirmation of any kind appears in the transcript; the recording is deliberately terminated at the moment payment would be taken, so the close cannot be verified from this file
Counter-evidence: the payment method was never settled — Klarna, credit card, in-house split and a possible corporate write-off were all still open when recording stopped
outcome.cash_collection_basis: unconfirmed — recording ends before payment is processed
outcome.next_step: Process payment, give immediate access to the programme, app and community, and book the 1:1 onboarding call with Trevor — all described by the rep, none evidenced on the recording

notable.note: A prospect with four disclosed joint complaints — including pain that triggers specifically on overhead pressing, and a knee with MRI-documented muscle loss — was sold a kettlebell programme with no clinician clearance sought, and was told the programme 'is going to get rid of any limitations or injuries that are existing'. Separately, the rep told this prospect that in-house payment plans exist ('splitting it into two or three'), on the same day another prospect was routed only to third-party financing with interest. The rep also disclosed his commission (600 dollars) on the recording, and took an unrelated call mid-discovery.

quality.notes: Heavy and sustained swapping, worse than the other calls in this batch. Whole exchanges invert: at 00:04:42 'This is like, nine years ago' and 'I played up until I was 18 years old' are labelled Farooq Bey but are the prospect; at 00:26:46 'And the benefit for yourself there, Mike, is speed' is labelled Mike Sicoli but is the rep; at 00:31:51-00:31:57 the in-house payment-plan statement is labelled Mike Sicoli but is plainly the rep; at 00:32:19 the Split It explanation is attributed to the rep but the product knowledge belongs to the prospect. Roles were resolved from content throughout. There is also a connection lag around 00:24:36-00:25:02 and the rep mentions a power cut.
